shape.query_layout: each MTP token is an independent qo_len=1 row with its own top-k
shape.kv_layout: request r owns HBM tokens [r*C/2,(r+1)*C/2) and Host tokens N/2+[r*C/2,(r+1)*C/2)

methods.copy: CPU gathers unique Host rows of the whole batch into pinned memory; H2D DMA plus native attention in one CUDA graph
methods.direct: Native attention directly reads mapped pinned Host DRAM through one VMM range

timing.direct: GPU events around a CUDA graph of repeated attention calls
timing.copy: GPU events around a CUDA graph; each call includes its H2D DMA
timing.cpu_pack: CPU index_select into the pinned buffer, excluded from copy GPU time
